issues.title: Ingest St. Francis County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $15,878,686 across 43 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($4,279,271), County Road Fund ($2,577,036), O & M of Jail ($2,495,120). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
